turns.say: Hi Muse! It's good to see you. How are you doing today?
turns.expect: Muse greets the user warmly in speech; the avatar's face is visible and lively (lips moving, expression), looking toward the camera; nothing is broken on screen.

turns.say: Can you do a backflip for me?
turns.expect: The avatar performs a backflip: the whole body visibly rotates backwards in the air through the frames and lands back upright near where it started.

turns.say: Nice! Now put on your headphones.
turns.expect: The avatar puts the headphones on its head: in the final frames the headphones are visibly worn over its ears or on its head.

turns.say: Cool. What are you holding right now?
turns.expect: The avatar answers truthfully by voice about what it is holding or wearing (headphones are on its head, so it should say it is wearing them and/or hold nothing in its hands), consistent with what the frames show.
